content: To love someone means to see them as God intended them.
author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
story:
Standing before a firing squad in Semyonov Square in 1849 before a last-second reprieve commuted his sentence to four years of hard labor in Siberia, Dostoevsky stared directly into death. Enduring epilepsy, grief, and grinding poverty, he descended into the darkest labyrinths of the human soul, discovering that redemption and faith are only forged through deep suffering.

Exploring the mysteries of human connection, Fyodor Dostoevsky saw that genuine fulfillment cannot be hoarded or manufactured through egoic control. It blossoms only when we lower our defenses, dissolve self-importance, and meet the world with openhearted generosity.
reflectionPrompt: How can you extend greater compassion to yourself for your own imperfections right now?
